210: ## Watch-Time-Per-Impression: The Metric That Matters
211: 
212: This channel optimizes for **WTPI**, not raw views or raw CTR.
213: 
214: ```
215: WTPI = CTR × (AVD / video_length)
216: ```
217: 
218: **Why WTPI > CTR alone:**
219: - A 20% CTR with 30% retention LOSES to 7% CTR with 65% retention
220: - YouTube's algorithm optimizes for total watch time generated per impression served
221: - A video that generates more watch time per impression gets MORE impressions
222: - High CTR + low retention = clickbait trap → algorithm reduces impressions
223: 
224: **Every title, thumbnail, and script decision should ask:** "Will this generate viewers who STAY?"
